package task

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteTaskInput holds input values.
type DeleteTaskInput struct {
	TaskID string
}

// DeleteTask removes task.
type DeleteTask struct {
	Tasks     repository.TaskRepository
	Publisher domain.EventPublisher
}

// Handle performs deletion and emits event.
func (uc DeleteTask) Handle(ctx context.Context, in DeleteTaskInput) error {
	task, err := uc.Tasks.Get(ctx, in.TaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := uc.Tasks.Delete(ctx, in.TaskID); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(ctx, domain.SubjectTaskDeleted, map[string]any{
		"task_id":   task.ID,
		"lesson_id": task.LessonID,
	})

	return nil
}
